name: Sung Jin-woo (early hunter)

appearance.outfit: dark hunter clothes, a dagger in each hand

skills.name: Kandiaru's Blessing
skills.does: His first skill as the System's player: purges poison, wards off disease, speeds recovery and halves damage taken below 30% health.

skills.name: Dagger Rush
skills.does: The upgrade of Dagger Toss, learned in the job-change quest: a storm of blade strikes that hits the target from every side.

skills.name: Mutilation
skills.does: The upgrade of Critical Attack: a burst of fast cuts aimed at vital points; it helped bring down the Ant King on Jeju Island.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.does: From the rune stone dropped after he beat Kang Tae-shik: he turns nearly invisible and hides his mana while it drains each second.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.does: A quest reward: killing intent that grips weaker foes with fear for a minute and halves their stats.

skills.name: Sprint
skills.does: Raises his movement speed by about 30% for a short time; it later grows into Quicksilver.

skills.name: Advanced Dagger Arts
skills.does: Daggers deal about a third more damage in his hands, at no mana cost.

personality: quiet, stubborn, fiercely protective of his family; grows cold and confident as he levels
story: The weakest E-rank hunter in Korea survives a hidden double dungeon and becomes the only player of a game-like System that lets him level up. At this stage he fights alone with daggers, stealth and speed, growing stronger with every daily quest and dungeon.

relations.how: sworn younger brother and first raid partner
younger sister he works to support
S-rank ally who later becomes his wife
job-change boss who becomes his first great shadow
a killer inspector he defeats; source of Stealth

forge.name: Nightfang Duelist
forge.tagline: A nobody who gets stronger every day: twin knives, a vanishing step and a glare that freezes foes.

skills.name: Ricochet Knives
skills.description: Thrown knives bounce from foe to foe, up to five.

skills.name: Vital Carve
skills.description: Flash down a line, cutting every enemy you pass.

skills.name: Killing Glare
skills.description: A stare full of menace stuns nearby foes and sharpens your blades.

skills.name: Frozen Nerve
skills.description: Fear roots everything inside a marked circle.

skills.name: Smoke Shroud
skills.description: A cloud of hidden cuts batters an area for four seconds.

skills.name: Whirl of Knives
skills.description: Spin with both knives out, slicing everything around you.

name: Sung Jin-woo (Shadow Monarch)

appearance.outfit: long black coat wrapped in shadow, twin daggers

skills.name: Shadow Extraction
skills.does: His job skill since the job-change quest ("Arise"): pulls the shadow out of a fallen foe and raises it as a loyal soldier; stronger foes take more tries.

skills.name: Shadow Exchange
skills.does: Swaps places with any of his shadow soldiers, however far away.

skills.name: Shadow Preservation
skills.does: Keeps his soldiers stored inside his own shadow, sensing their state and calling them out at will.

skills.name: Monarch's Domain
skills.does: Spreads his power over the ground around him, raising every summoned shadow's stats by half.

skills.name: Ruler's Authority
skills.does: The evolved form of Commander's Touch (a rune from Igris): telekinesis that grabs, hurls and pins things and people.

skills.name: Dragon's Fear
skills.does: From the rune stone of the dragon Kamish: a scream full of mana that sends weaker beings nearby, allies included, into panic.

personality: calm, ruthless to enemies, gentle with family; carries the weight of a war alone
story: The Shadow Monarch Ashborn chose Jin-woo as his successor, and Jin-woo inherits his title as the King of the Dead. With an army of shadows he becomes the only Monarch fighting for humanity in the war between the Rulers and the Monarchs.

relations.how: the first Shadow Monarch, who chose him as heir
shadow of the Ant King, his most eager general
the Monarch of Destruction, his final foe
a National Level hunter he defeats, then befriends

forge.name: Umbral Sovereign
forge.tagline: Every fallen foe stands back up in your colours. Swap places with your soldiers and crush the field with a thought.

skills.name: Grave Tide
skills.description: Soldiers of shade swarm a circle, striking everything inside for four seconds.

skills.name: Bound in Gloom
skills.description: Dark hands rise and root every foe in the circle.

skills.name: Unseen Grip
skills.description: An invisible hand presses the ground until it cracks and keeps shaking.

skills.name: Dread Howl
skills.description: A scream of raw power stuns those nearby and lifts your damage.

skills.name: Shade Swap
skills.description: Vanish into a soldier's shadow down the line, cutting through all between.

skills.name: Night Court
skills.description: A ring of black blades closes around a circle and locks it in place.

name: Cha Hae-in

appearance.outfit: light hunter armour over a fitted suit, a long sword

skills.name: Swordsmanship (the Dancer)
skills.does: Fast, flowing sword work so graceful that it earned her the nickname "the Dancer".

skills.name: Sword of Light
skills.does: Her signature sword power: lifts her speed and cutting strength for a burst of decisive strikes.

skills.name: Mana sense
skills.does: She feels other people's mana (most hunters smell foul to her), which lets her judge an opponent's strength.

personality: earnest, reserved, utterly focused on her sword; warm with those she trusts
story: The only female S-rank hunter in Korea and vice-master of the Hunters Guild, she fights at Jin-woo's side from the Jeju Island raid onward. He saves her three times, and she later marries him and has a son, Suho.

relations.how: comrade, love interest and later husband
her guild master in the Hunters Guild
nearly killed her on Jeju Island

forge.name: Gleamstep Fencer
forge.tagline: A fencer who moves like music: bright lunges, spinning cuts and a sense for where the danger hides.

skills.name: Sunlit Lunge
skills.description: Flash forward down a line, cutting everything you pass.

skills.name: Dawn Cleave
skills.description: A held column of light burns along the line.

skills.name: Spinning Waltz
skills.description: Turn and turn again, slicing everything around you.

skills.name: Twirl Rush
skills.description: Charge through a line of foes, knocking them aside.

skills.name: Flash Verdict
skills.description: A strike too fast to see stuns its target briefly.

skills.name: Ring of Edges
skills.description: A ring of blades seals a circle and holds it still.

name: Thomas Andre

appearance.outfit: huge frame; golden spirit armour when he powers up

skills.name: Power Smash
skills.does: Gathers his mana into one fist for a single crushing punch.

skills.name: Capture
skills.does: Drags a target toward him with tremendous force; he pulled the dragon Kamish out of the sky with it.

skills.name: Ruler's Authority
skills.does: As a vessel of the Rulers he holds a limited telekinesis that grows with his power.

skills.name: Spiritual Body Manifestation
skills.does: Coats him in golden armour shaped like the Rulers, raising both his attack and his defence.

personality: loud, proud and fearless; respects strength and keeps his word
story: Ranked first in the world among the five National Level Hunters, the American guild master is nicknamed Goliath for his size and strength. After losing a fight to Jin-woo he becomes his friend and gives him Kamish's Wrath, the strongest magic weapon in the world.

relations.how: beaten by him, then a firm friend
risked himself to save Thomas from the Monarchs

forge.name: Colossus Brawler
forge.tagline: A walking fortress who pulls enemies in and flattens them with one fist.

skills.name: Mountain Punch
skills.description: One punch splits the ground in a long line.

skills.name: Bull Charge
skills.description: Barrel down a line, throwing enemies aside.

skills.name: Gilded Roar
skills.description: A bellow stuns everyone near and pumps up your damage.

skills.name: Halo Ray
skills.description: A column of golden light burns along a line.

skills.name: Skyfall Drop
skills.description: Jump high and crash down on a circle of foes.

skills.name: Fault Line
skills.description: Stomp until the ground at a point cracks and keeps shaking.

name: Liu Zhigang

appearance.outfit: hunter's coat and a long sword

skills.name: Mana-charged sword
skills.does: Floods his sword with mana and releases it as a single sweeping blast; with it he cleared the sky over Jeju of flying ants.

skills.name: Ruler's Authority
skills.does: As a vessel of the Rulers he moves things with telekinesis.

personality: composed and confident; quick to respect real strength
story: The strongest hunter in China and second in the world among the National Level Hunters, he is one of the humans chosen as a vessel by the Rulers. He meets Jin-woo at the annual guild conference and stays on good terms with him.

forge.name: Skyrender Swordsman
forge.tagline: One swing, one wave of force: a swordsman who clears the sky and holds foes with an unseen hand.

skills.name: Sky Sweep
skills.description: A blade of force holds a line and burns it.

skills.name: Earth Cleaver
skills.description: A downward stroke splits the ground along a line.

skills.name: Crossing Step
skills.description: Step through a line of foes, cutting each one.

skills.name: Wheel of Steel
skills.description: Spin the sword around you for a few seconds.

skills.name: Still the Field
skills.description: An invisible grip roots everything in a circle.

skills.name: Snap Strike
skills.description: A lightning-quick thrust stuns its target.

name: Baek Yoon-ho

appearance.outfit: guild master's suit; turns into a huge white tiger

skills.name: Beast Transformation (partial)
skills.does: Turns part of his body into a white tiger's, gaining claws, speed and strength.

skills.name: Beast Transformation (full)
skills.does: Becomes a giant white tiger, with greatly raised strength, speed and stamina.

skills.name: Tiger claws
skills.does: Tears into foes with the claws of his beast form.

personality: sharp-eyed, proud and practical; an old hand at guild politics
story: An S-rank transformation specialist and master of the White Tiger Guild, he is the first S-rank to notice that Jin-woo keeps getting stronger. His old friends Min Byung-gyu and Lee Eunseok, both S-ranks, die in the Jeju Island raids.

relations.how: first to spot his growth; tries to recruit him
old friend lost on Jeju Island

forge.name: Frostmane Prowler
forge.tagline: Half warrior, half great cat: pounce, rend and roar until the pack scatters.

skills.name: Stalker's Lunge
skills.description: Leap far and crash onto a circle of prey.

skills.name: Stampede
skills.description: Charge down a line, bowling foes over.

skills.name: Rending Spin
skills.description: Whirl with claws out, shredding everything near.

skills.name: Claw Furrow
skills.description: Rake the ground so hard it splits along a line.

skills.name: Jungle Howl
skills.description: A roar that stuns those close and stokes your fury.

skills.name: Pale Ring
skills.description: A ring of icy claws freezes a circle.

name: Choi Jong-in

appearance.outfit: neat suit, magic rings on his fingers

skills.name: Flame Spear
skills.does: Hurls a spear of fire that drives straight through its target.

skills.name: Flame Dragon
skills.does: Calls up a dragon of fire that crashes into the enemy with intense heat.

skills.name: Guided fireballs
skills.does: Summons huge fireballs and steers them so that only enemies are burned.

personality: cool, precise and a little vain; a responsible guild leader
story: An S-rank fire mage and master of the Hunters Guild, one of Korea's biggest. He later faces the Architect's statues alongside Cha Hae-in and Woo Jin-chul.

forge.name: Ember Lancer Magus
forge.tagline: Spears of fire, steered embers and a burning wyrm from the sky.

skills.name: Cinder Javelin
skills.description: A white-hot spear strikes down a line and stuns.

skills.name: Wyrmfall
skills.description: A burning serpent drops at the end of the line and explodes.

skills.name: Guided Embers
skills.description: A slow fire orb sears foes near it, then bursts.

skills.name: Ember Rain
skills.description: Fire falls on a circle for four seconds.

skills.name: Scorch Ray
skills.description: A held column of flame burns along a line.

skills.name: Leaping Flame
skills.description: A tongue of fire jumps from foe to foe, up to five.

name: Go Gun-hee

appearance.outfit: elderly chairman in a suit; golden light when he fights

skills.name: Ruler's Authority
skills.does: As a vessel of the Rulers he bends the battlefield with telekinesis.

skills.name: Fragment of Brilliant Light
skills.does: Lets the golden, divine power of the Rulers flow through his body.

personality: wise, steady and kind; carries his country's gates on his shoulders
story: An S-rank hunter and Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association, which oversees every hunter, gate and guild in Korea. He is secretly a vessel of the Rulers, but age and illness keep him from his full power, and he dies fighting the Monarchs.

relations.how: the Association chairman he deals with
his inspector and successor as chairman

forge.name: Lantern Patriarch
forge.tagline: An old guardian who still stands in the gate: unmovable, bright and hard-hitting.

skills.name: Elder's Rebuke
skills.description: A command that stuns those near and steels your strikes.

skills.name: Gatekeeper Blow
skills.description: A punch that splits the ground in a line.

skills.name: Gleaming Column
skills.description: A pillar of light burns along a line.

skills.name: Halo Bind
skills.description: A ring of light roots everything in a circle.

skills.name: Shining Ring
skills.description: A ring of light-blades locks a circle in place.

skills.name: Heavy Footfall
skills.description: The ground at a point cracks and keeps shaking.

name: Igris

appearance.outfit: red-tinged full plate armour and a longsword

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.does: Peerless sword work; he can overwhelm opponents even without his blade.

skills.name: Commander's Touch
skills.does: Telekinesis (Jin-woo took it from Igris's rune stone) that pulls things to him, such as his sword back to his hand.

skills.name: Shadow regeneration
skills.does: As a shadow soldier he rebuilds himself as long as his master has mana.

personality: loyal, proud and disciplined; kneels to his master after every battle
story: The knight boss of the job-change quest, once a servant of the first Shadow Monarch, who was told to test his master's successor. Beaten by Jin-woo, he becomes his first great shadow soldier and rises to Marshal.

relations.how: his master since the job-change quest
the master he served eons ago

forge.name: Scarlet Oath Blade
forge.tagline: A sworn knight who answers every command with a perfect cut.

skills.name: Kneeling Cleave
skills.description: A two-handed stroke that splits the ground along a line.

skills.name: Plume Charge
skills.description: Charge down a line, shoving foes aside.

skills.name: Red Pivot
skills.description: Spin in place with the blade out, cutting all around.

skills.name: Lunge of Honour
skills.description: Flash down a line, cutting each foe you pass.

skills.name: Liege's Call
skills.description: A battle cry that stuns those near and sharpens your strikes.

skills.name: Rampart Drop
skills.description: Leap high and land sword-first in a circle.

name: Beru

appearance.outfit: black insect body, wings and long claws

skills.name: Claw frenzy
skills.does: Shreds foes with claws at blinding speed; he can clear an A-rank dungeon alone.

skills.name: Healing Magic
skills.does: Heals wounds, his own and others', with magic he took from a healer he devoured as the Ant King.

skills.name: Gluttony
skills.does: By eating a being he absorbs its skills and knowledge.

skills.name: Size Manipulation
skills.does: Changes his size at will.

personality: fanatically devoted, dramatic and eager to prove himself to his king
story: The shadow of the Ant King that ravaged Jeju Island, extracted by Jin-woo after a hard fight. He joins as a General, rises to Marshal, and later trains Jin-woo's son.

forge.name: Chitin Reaver
forge.tagline: A winged hunter that eats what it kills and comes back stronger.

skills.name: Devour Rush
skills.description: Rush down a line, flinging prey aside.

skills.name: Carapace Spin
skills.description: Spin with claws out, cutting all around.

skills.name: Numbing Sting
skills.description: Paralysing venom roots everything in a circle.

skills.name: Spore Cloud
skills.description: A stinging cloud batters a circle for four seconds.

skills.name: Wingdrop
skills.description: Fly up and crash down on a circle of foes.

skills.name: Hive Shriek
skills.description: A shriek stuns those near and drives you into a frenzy.

name: The Ant King

appearance.outfit: armoured insect body with long claws

skills.name: Silent kill
skills.does: Moves so fast that hunters lose their heads before they see him.

skills.name: Paralysis Poison
skills.does: Venom brewed from the island's sea creatures and strengthened with magic that freezes its victims.

skills.name: Gluttony
skills.does: Eats fallen hunters to take their skills, which is how he learned to heal and to speak.

skills.name: Regeneration
skills.does: Recovers from wounds again and again in the middle of battle.

personality: a cold, clever predator that learns from everything it eats
story: The S-rank king born on Jeju Island after the ants overran it, he kills Japan's strongest hunter Goto Ryuji in one blow and cuts through the raid's S-ranks until Jin-woo arrives. Jin-woo kills him and raises his shadow as Beru.

relations.how: the hunter who finally killed him
what he becomes as a shadow

forge.name: Hive Tyrant
forge.tagline: Fast as a blade, poisonous as the sea: the swarm's ruler hunts the strongest first.

skills.name: Silent Behead
skills.description: Vanish down a line, cutting all you pass.

skills.name: Crushing Mandible
skills.description: A bite that splits the ground in a line.

skills.name: Paralytic Mire
skills.description: Venom roots everything in a circle.

skills.name: Tremor Burrow
skills.description: Tunnels shake the ground at a point again and again.

skills.name: Feeding Frenzy
skills.description: Thrash around, striking everything near.

skills.name: Brood Roar
skills.description: A roar that stuns those near and feeds your rage.

name: Tusk

appearance.outfit: hulking high orc shaman in tribal robes

skills.name: Gravitation Magic
skills.does: Crushes and pins enemies under heavy gravity.

skills.name: Hymns
skills.does: Chanted spells of many kinds, some shielding and strengthening allies, others destructive.

skills.name: Shadow regeneration
skills.does: Rebuilds himself as long as his master has mana.

personality: calculating and devout; the first to recognise a Monarch
story: Once Kargalgan, the high orc shaman boss of an A-rank dungeon who nearly wipes out a guild strike team and first realises Jin-woo is a Monarch. As a shadow of Elite Knight grade, later Commander, he is as strong as an S-rank hunter.

forge.name: Gravity Chanter
forge.tagline: Every verse makes the ground heavier: sing the enemy flat, then bring the sky down.

skills.name: Heavy Sky
skills.description: Gravity pins everything in a circle to the ground.

skills.name: Crushing Pull
skills.description: The ground at a point buckles and keeps shaking.

skills.name: Battle Chant
skills.description: A chant that stuns those close and empowers your spells.

skills.name: Chorus Storm
skills.description: A storm of force falls on a circle for four seconds.

skills.name: Totem Spark
skills.description: A slow orb zaps foes near it, then bursts.

skills.name: Bonfire Comet
skills.description: A blazing stone is hurled to the end of a line.

name: Iron

appearance.outfit: heavy dark armour and a large shield

skills.name: Shout of Provocation
skills.does: A bellow that makes enemies forget everything and attack him; it fails on foes stronger than he is.

skills.name: Shadow regeneration
skills.does: Shrugs off blows that would kill a living S-rank, rebuilding himself while his master has mana.

personality: loud, simple-minded and enthusiastic; copies Igris's habits
story: Kim Chul, a hunter who turned on Jin-woo during the red gate, is cut down by Igris; Jin-woo raises him on the spot as the shadow Iron. He serves as the army's front-line tank and rises to Elite Knight.

relations.how: the knight who killed him, and whom he imitates
fellow front-liner from the same red gate

forge.name: Bulwark Bellower
forge.tagline: Loud, stubborn and impossible to ignore: make them hit you, then hit back.

skills.name: Look at Me
skills.description: A huge yell stuns those near and fires you up.

skills.name: Wall Shove
skills.description: Shield first, push down a line and scatter foes.

skills.name: Shield Crash
skills.description: Slam the shield down, splitting the ground in a line.

skills.name: Boulder Leap
skills.description: Jump in and land heavily on a circle.

skills.name: Stubborn Spin
skills.description: Swing around wildly, hitting everything near.

skills.name: Bedrock Stamp
skills.description: Stamp until the ground at a point keeps shaking.

name: Tank

appearance.outfit: a giant ice bear made of shadow

skills.name: Bulldozer charge
skills.does: Plows through a horde of demons, sending them flying like bowling pins.

skills.name: Crushing blow
skills.does: Hits hard enough to kill a naga with a single swing.

skills.name: Shadow regeneration
skills.does: Rebuilds himself while his master has mana.

story: The alpha ice bear of the red gate where Jin-woo was trapped in a frozen world, raised as a Knight-grade shadow about as strong as an A-rank hunter. He proves his worth in the Tokyo dungeon break.

relations.how: fellow front-liner from the same red gate

forge.name: Glacier Bruin
forge.tagline: A bear of the frozen wastes that walks straight through the crowd.

skills.name: Snowplow Rush
skills.description: Charge down a line, throwing foes aside.

skills.name: Paw Smash
skills.description: A swipe that splits the ground along a line.

skills.name: Rime Field
skills.description: Ice crystals erupt down a line and slow foes.

skills.name: Whiteout Roar
skills.description: A roar that stuns those near and stokes your rage.

skills.name: Bellyflop
skills.description: Leap and land on a circle of foes.

skills.name: Ice Shelf Crack
skills.description: The ground at a point cracks and keeps shaking.

name: Bellion

appearance.outfit: a winged knight with a blade that stretches like a whip

skills.name: Extendable blade
skills.does: His blade stretches with his will like a whip, lashing and ensnaring foes at a distance or closing into a sword.

skills.name: Flight
skills.does: Flies on his wings at immense speed.

skills.name: Shadow regeneration
skills.does: Rebuilds himself while his master has mana.

story: Born from the fruit of the World Tree, he was the first shadow soldier ever made by Ashborn and his lieutenant through eons of war. The only Grand Marshal, he is the strongest shadow in existence.

relations.how: Marshal below him; they argue about Suho's schooling

forge.name: Lash Marshal
forge.tagline: A winged general whose blade reaches across the whole battlefield.

skills.name: Coiling Lash
skills.description: The blade snakes from foe to foe, up to five.

skills.name: Snaring Coil
skills.description: The blade wraps a circle and roots all inside.

skills.name: Stoop Strike
skills.description: Dive from the air onto a circle of foes.

skills.name: Wingcut Pass
skills.description: Fly through a line, cutting all you pass.

skills.name: Cyclone Lash
skills.description: Whirl the whip-blade around you for a few seconds.

skills.name: Long Reach Thrust
skills.description: A snapping thrust down a line that stuns.

name: The Statue of God

appearance.outfit: a colossal seated stone idol with a blank face that turns into a grin

skills.name: Eye lasers
skills.does: Fires beams from its eyes that vaporise anyone standing above a set height.

skills.name: Stomp
skills.does: Rises from its throne and crushes those in its path underfoot.

skills.name: The Commandments
skills.does: Its temple obeys three rules (revere God, praise God, prove your faith); breaking them turns the room into an execution.

skills.name: Temple statues
skills.does: Armed statues guard the exits and musician statues hold the key to the second rule.

personality: silent, cruel and patient; it smiles before it kills
story: The giant idol on the throne of Cartenon Temple, the hidden double dungeon where Jin-woo's party is slaughtered and he becomes the System's player. It was made in the image of the Absolute Being, and Jin-woo returns at level 100 to break it.

relations.how: nearly killed him; beaten in the rematch
the temple's maker, who also commands its statues

forge.name: Idol of the Throne
forge.tagline: A stone giant that judges from its throne: kneel, sing, or burn.

skills.name: Judging Stare
skills.description: Twin beams burn a line from end to end.

skills.name: Sudden Verdict
skills.description: A flash down a line that stuns.

skills.name: Heel of Heaven
skills.description: A stamp that splits the ground along a line.

skills.name: Throne Quake
skills.description: The temple floor at a point keeps shaking.

skills.name: Circle of Penance
skills.description: A sacred circle roots every sinner inside.

skills.name: Ring of Wardens

name: The Architect

appearance.outfit: an angel-like stone figure

skills.name: Statue puppets

skills.name: Ten-minute trial
skills.does: Sets a deadline of ten minutes; if it runs out, the System kills the player.

skills.name: Trance
skills.does: Puts his opponent into a trance while he works his ritual.

story: The maker of the System and of Cartenon Temple, who worked with the Shadow Monarch to find a vessel. When Jin-woo returns he dominates at first, tries to take back the System and sacrifice the hunters, and is killed after the Shadow Monarch has locked him out.

relations.how: the player he built the System for, and his killer
worked with him to find a vessel
sent his statues against her and others

forge.name: Marble Puppeteer
forge.tagline: Build, command, and close the trap before the timer runs out.

skills.name: Chisel Volley
skills.description: Stone shards burst along a line and slow foes.

skills.name: Column Drop
skills.description: A pillar is hurled to the end of a line and shatters.

skills.name: Countdown Circle
skills.description: A ticking glyph roots everything inside.

skills.name: Gallery of Blades
skills.description: Carved blades ring a circle and lock it.

skills.name: Blueprint Orb

name: Baran

appearance.outfit: a demon king riding a wyvern

skills.name: Lightning Breath
skills.does: Sprays lightning from his mouth, stunning what it hits.

skills.name: White Flames
skills.does: Turns himself into a bolt of lightning and strikes at high speed.

skills.name: Hell's Army
skills.does: Opens portals and pours an army of demons onto the field.

personality: arrogant and cruel; looks down on all lesser beings
story: The King of Demons and Monarch of White Flames, and the first Monarch Jin-woo defeats, as the boss at the top of the System's Demon Castle. His war mount, the wyvern Kaisellin, becomes Jin-woo's flying shadow Kaisel.

relations.how: beaten by him at the top of the Demon Castle
his wyvern mount, later Jin-woo's shadow
demon noble who later inherits his title

forge.name: Pale Storm Overlord
forge.tagline: A lord of white lightning who arrives as a bolt and leaves the field burning.
